groups.note: E73・E74 は「하나의 주권（一つの主権）」「하나의 국토, 하나의 국민, 하나의 문화」を「a single nation without boundaries」「citizens of this world, sharing a culture of love」と言い換えている
diff: The Korean original says that in that nation there is only one sovereignty, and the whole world is joined into one land, one people and one culture (English edition: “a single nation without boundaries,” “citizens of this world, sharing a culture of love”).
